Definition

This identifier, known as the 'MoE Number' or 'School Number', is used by the education sector to identify an NZ education institution. These identifiers can be looked up at the [educationcounts.govt.nz](https://www.educationcounts.govt.nz/directories/list-of-nz-schools) website.
